description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data within the Darija Open Dataset, specifically showing the composition of its 23,108 total entries. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different data category. The largest slice, colored green, is labeled “Pending Translations” and comprises approximately 45,387 entries. Next is a blue slice labeled “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” representing around 30,000 entries, followed by a tan slice labeled “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” with approximately 43,000 entries. A smaller, yellow slice is labeled “Translated Sentences” and appears to represent a smaller proportion of the data. The final two slices are a light blue slice labeled “Extra + Augmented Data” and an orange slice labeled “Moroccan Names”, both representing relatively small proportions of the total. A legend is provided to the left of the chart, identifying each slice by label and color. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and the slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest based on their numerical value.
